title: Diameter of Binary Tree
prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, return the length of the diameter of the tree. The diameter is the length of the longest path between any two nodes in a tree. This path may or may not pass through the root. The length of a path between two nodes is the number of edges between them.
hints: For each node, the longest path through it = max depth of left subtree + max depth of right subtree.
Use a helper that returns the max depth from a node. While computing depth, also compute diameter through that node.
Track a global max diameter. At each node: diameter = leftDepth + rightDepth; update max.
